statement: When S = CAUTION, the Go recommendation type remains available but is presented with a caution qualifier (e.g., "Proceed with caution"). The recommendation type is unchanged — it is still a Go/no-go assessment. The qualifier communicates that conditions are elevated and the fisher should exercise additional vigilance. This design preserves set containment (Go ∈ A_AI(CAUTION) and Go ∈ A_AI(SAFE) — same type in both) while ensuring the fisher understands that CAUTION-mode advice carries a different risk profile than SAFE-mode advice.
notes: The word "automatically" does NOT appear here. The verbs are "presented", "communicates", "understands" — all presentation-layer. This is the parallel canonical statement to line 791 and it explicitly frames the qualifier as messaging.
